website/public/wasm/media/luiskr_media.js
Sourcesrc/website/public/wasm/media/luiskr_media.js
UX surfaceBoot surfaces: what the user sees first on each bundle.

Members

Media

Public wasm surface — one media canvas per instance.

frame

frame — draw the current texture. No clock needed (static until an upload lands); the bridge calls this on resize/scroll or per rAF — drawing costs one 6-vertex call.

  • @param _dt Seconds since last call (unused — media is static
  • @param {number} _dt

init

init — device + pipeline + sampler; the bind group builds on the first upload.

  • @param canvas The widget's dedicated canvas.
  • @param device The shared GPUDevice (one per page, from the JS bridge).
  • @returns Ok on a live surface, Err(JsValue) on failure.
  • @param {HTMLCanvasElement} canvas
  • @param {GPUDevice} device

constructor

Media::new — un-initialized widget; init must follow.

push_frame

push_frame — stream a WebCodecs VideoFrame into the texture. Same GPU→GPU path as bitmaps — video frames upload per requestVideoFrameCallback, NOT per rAF.

  • @param frame The decoded frame.
  • @param w Frame width px.
  • @param h Frame height px.
  • @param {VideoFrame} frame
  • @param {number} w
  • @param {number} h

resize

resize — canvas-bitmap change → surface re-configure. The projection is pure CSS px (rect/viewport — see State doc), so no size state updates here.

  • @param _w Device-pixel width (element-side; unused — see doc).
  • @param _h Device-pixel height.
  • @param {number} _w
  • @param {number} _h

set_size

set_size — the canvas's CSS-pixel size (rect + viewport).

  • @param w Canvas width in CSS pixels.
  • @param h Canvas height in CSS pixels.
  • @param {number} w
  • @param {number} h

set_uv_rect

set_uv_rect — the cover-fit crop window: which sub-rect of the texture maps onto the widget. JS computes the aspect math (single responsibility — the shader just samples it).

  • @param u Crop window left edge, 0..1.
  • @param v Crop window top edge, 0..1.
  • @param du Crop window width, 0..1.
  • @param dv Crop window height, 0..1.
  • @param {number} u
  • @param {number} v
  • @param {number} du
  • @param {number} dv

upload_bitmap

upload_bitmap — paint a decoded ImageBitmap (JS did the decode off-main-thread via createImageBitmap). GPU→GPU copy — the fastest possible path and zero wasm-side decode code.

  • @param bitmap The decoded image.
  • @param w Bitmap width px.
  • @param h Bitmap height px.
  • @param {ImageBitmap} bitmap
  • @param {number} w
  • @param {number} h
